sentences.zh: 他们启动了两套独立的谈判，对象基本上是两拨不同的人。

sentences.en: And key to all of this is keeping the two tracks truly separate.
sentences.zh: 这一切的关键在于保持这两条轨道真正独立。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What Biden and Democratic leaders quickly find in the spring heading into the early summer of 2021 is that that is going to be much, much harder than they hoped.
sentences.zh: 拜登和民主党领导人在2021年春末夏初之际很快发现，这要比他们希望的难得多得多。

sentences.en: That there are currents of real intense dissension and distrust within their own party.
sentences.zh: 他们的党内存在着极其激烈的不满和不信任的暗流。

sentences.en: Because progressives in the House, they're not that interested in seeing a modest bipartisan infrastructure bill pass
sentences.zh: 因为众议院的进步派对于看到一项温和的跨党派基础设施法案通过

sentences.en: if they're not going to get their side of the agenda done as well.
sentences.zh: 并没有那么大兴趣，如果他们自己的议程无法同时得到推进的话。

sentences.en: And folks more to the right, certainly Republicans and conservative Democrats like Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema,
sentences.zh: 而更倾向右翼的人士，当然包括共和党人和保守派民主党人如乔·曼钦和克尔斯滕·西内马，

sentences.en: they're not that interested in hammering out this compromise on infrastructure
sentences.zh: 他们对敲定这项关于基础设施的妥协方案也没有太大兴趣，

sentences.en: if there's any kind of built-in assumption that that means that they're going to be for all this other stuff when the time comes.
sentences.zh: 如果其中包含任何默认假设，即这意味着当时间到来时他们将支持所有这些其他东西的话。

sentences.en: They have widely disparate governing ambitions, and it ultimately becomes impossible at the end of June, when on the same day...
sentences.zh: 他们有着截然不同的施政野心，到6月底时，这一切最终变得不可能实现，当时在同一天……

sentences.en: We have a deal.
sentences.zh: 我们达成协议了。

sentences.en: Biden goes out and announces that he has reached a deal on infrastructure with a group of centrist Democrats and mainstream Republicans.
sentences.zh: 拜登公开宣布他已与一群中间派民主党人和主流共和党人就基础设施达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: This reminds me of the days we used to get an awful lot done up in the United States Congress.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了我们过去在美国国会里能办成非常多事情的日子。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi, Speaker of the House...
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西，众议院议长……

sentences.en: So let me be really clear on this.
sentences.zh: 所以在此我要把话说得非常清楚。

sentences.en: ...goes out and says...
sentences.zh: ……公开发话称……

sentences.en: We will not take up a bill in the House until the Senate passes the bipartisan bill and a reconciliation bill.
sentences.zh: 在参议院通过跨党派法案和调解法案之前，我们不会在众议院审议该法案。

sentences.en: That thing is never going to get a vote unless we get Build Back Better done as well.
sentences.zh: 除非我们也搞定了“重建更好未来”法案，否则那个东西休想得到投票通过。

sentences.en: And with that, a linkage is created that becomes incredibly challenging for Democrats to navigate.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是，一种绑定关系就此产生，这让民主党人极难应对。

sentences.en: And what I remember about this moment is that in the absence of anybody else, like the president, saying the certainty what the party stands for,
sentences.zh: 我对这一刻的记忆是，在没有任何其他人（比如总统）明确表态该党主张什么的情况下，

sentences.en: Pelosi says, I'm telling you what it stands for, and it's for a big progressive vision because I'm now linking a moderate infrastructure bill
sentences.zh: 佩洛西说，我来告诉你们它主张什么，它主张宏大的进步主义愿景，因为我现在把温和的基础设施法案

sentences.en: with a very progressive program of social change.
sentences.zh: 与一项非常激进的社会变革计划捆绑在了一起。

sentences.en: And Michael, Biden himself responds to Pelosi going out and saying that
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，拜登本人对佩洛西发表这番言论的回应是

sentences.en: by initially echoing her and saying, yeah, fair enough, I'm not going to sign infrastructure unless I get Build Back Better as well.
sentences.zh: 最初随声附和道：是的，言之有理，除非我也能通过“重建更好未来”法案，否则我不会签署基础设施法案。

sentences.en: For Biden to say that is shocking to the people who have been negotiating the infrastructure bill with him.
sentences.zh: 拜登说出这话，让那些一直与他协商基础设施法案的人感到震惊。

sentences.en: People like Manchin and Sinema, Republicans like Susan Collins and Rob Portman and Mitt Romney,
sentences.zh: 像曼钦和西内马这样的人，以及像苏珊·柯林斯、罗布·波特曼和米特·罗姆尼这样的共和党人，

sentences.en: they have not been laboring over here on the infrastructure bill with an eye towards, you know, passing that as a component of a massive liberal agenda.
sentences.zh: 他们在此处辛苦谈判基础设施法案时，可不是抱着将其作为庞大自由主义议程的一部分来通过的目的。

sentences.en: So why did Biden do it?
sentences.zh: 那拜登为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Because he's driving all over the road, Michael.
sentences.zh: 因为他开车到处乱窜，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Like this is the common theme in everything that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 就像这是我们正在讨论的所有事情的共同主题。

sentences.en: He's trying to tell the left what it needs to hear, and he's trying to tell centrists what they need to hear.
sentences.zh: 他试图告诉左翼他们需要听什么，他也试图告诉温和派他们需要听什么。

sentences.en: So he goes and blurts out, I won't sign it unless I also get Build Back Better.
sentences.zh: 于是他脱口而出，除非我也得到“重建美好未来”，否则我不会签署。

sentences.en: He and his advisors get bombarded by folks on the Hill saying, what on earth was that?
sentences.zh: 他和他的顾问们遭到国会山各方人士的轰炸，质问那到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Biden calls Republican senators and promises that he's going to walk back his comments.
sentences.zh: 拜登给共和党参议员打电话，承诺他会收回自己的言论。

sentences.en: And he does walk back his comments.
sentences.zh: 他也确实收回了自己的言论。

sentences.en: But what you end up with, Michael, is this kind of, you know, be generous to call it strategic ambiguity.
sentences.zh: 但你最终得到的结果，迈克尔，是一种，你知道的，把它叫做战略模糊未免太慷慨了。

sentences.en: It's just sort of like non-strategic ambiguity.
sentences.zh: 它有点像非战略性的模糊。

sentences.en: And where we find ourselves at the beginning of July is not really clear.
sentences.zh: 而我们在七月初所处的境地其实并不明朗。

sentences.en: Like, are these things linked or not?
sentences.zh: 比如说，这些事情是有联系的还是没有？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And as it happens, the decision, even if it was temporary, to embrace that linkage, sets in motion a series of events that leads to one of these bills not passing,
sentences.zh: 而且碰巧的是，即使是暂时的拥抱这种联系的决定，引发了一系列事件，导致其中一项法案未能通过，

sentences.en: which is Build Back Better, and the other infrastructure just barely making it through.
sentences.zh: 那就是“重建美好未来”，而另一项基础设施法案则勉强通过。

sentences.en: Just barely making it through and turning into an enormous political missed opportunity for Biden and his party.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是勉强通过，并变成了一次巨大的政治错失良机，对拜登和他的政党来说。

sentences.en: Because what happens instead is they strike an infrastructure deal in June and then spend the
sentences.zh: 因为相反发生的是，他们在六月达成了一项基础设施协议，然后把

sentences.en: entire summer in this excruciating game of chicken with progressive Democrats and Build Back Better
sentences.zh: 整个夏天都耗在这场极其痛苦的胆小鬼博弈中，进步派民主党人和“重建美好未来”法案

sentences.en: on the one side, centrist Democrats and the infrastructure legislation on the other.
sentences.zh: 在一边，温和派民主党人和基础设施立法在另一边。

sentences.en: And Biden himself is not stepping in to tell anybody, I think you're dead wrong about this and you have to knock it off and do things my way.
sentences.zh: 而拜登本人并没有介入并告诉任何人，我认为你们在这个问题上大错特错了，你们必须停止并按我的方式做事。

sentences.en: And he also can give people the distinct impression, whether he's talking to Rob Portman, the Republican senator from Ohio, or members of the solid left in the House and Senate,
sentences.zh: 而且他还会给人们留下一种鲜明的印象，无论是他在与俄亥俄州共和党参议员罗布·波特曼交谈，还是与众议院和参议院坚定的左翼成员交谈，

sentences.en: that at the end of the day, he's basically sympathetic to the way they're approaching things.
sentences.zh: 那就是归根结底，他基本上同情他们处理问题的方式。

sentences.en: And it becomes very, very easy for everybody involved in the standoff to think that they are truly on the same side as the president.
sentences.zh: 这就使得参与这场对峙的所有人都非常非常容易地认为，他们确实和总统站在同一边。

sentences.en: You know, summer turns to fall, Biden goes to the Hill multiple times in late September and October, time after time, Nancy Pelosi thinks that he's going to step in and sort
sentences.zh: 你知道，夏天转入秋天，拜登在九月下旬和十月多次前往国会山，一次又一次，南希·佩洛西认为他会介入并化解

sentences.en: of break this logjam.
sentences.zh: 这种僵局。

sentences.en: And time after time, he just refuses to do it.
sentences.zh: 但一次又一次，他就是拒绝这么做。

sentences.en: And all the while, his approval ratings are falling and falling and falling.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他的支持率在不断地下跌、下跌、再下跌。

sentences.en: And in fact, they fall to the point that Democrats just get clobbered in the off-year election in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们的下跌程度导致民主党人在弗吉尼亚州的中期选举中彻底遭到痛击。

sentences.en: And that is finally what presents the spur that the administration needs to say, you know what, we're going to pass infrastructure now.
sentences.zh: 这最终成为了行政当局所需的刺激，让他们说，你知道吗，我们现在就要通过基础设施法案。

sentences.en: And by the time that happens, what could have been a set of meaningful victories becomes this kind of sour consolation prize that nobody in the party feels particularly good about.
sentences.zh: 而当这一切发生时，原本可能是一系列有意义的胜利，却变成了一种酸溜溜的安慰奖，党内没有人对此感到特别高兴。

sentences.en: Alex, what you just described, lawmakers feeling like the president is sympathetic to them,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，你刚才描述的，议员们觉得总统同情他们，

sentences.en: whether they are Republican senators or progressives in the House, you know, could be described as
sentences.zh: 无论他们是共和党参议员还是众议院的进步派，你知道的，这可以被描述为

sentences.en: someone who's just very empathetic, or it could be described as someone speaking out of both sides of his mouth.
sentences.zh: 一个非常富有同情心的人，或者也可以被描述为两面三刀、言行不一的人。

sentences.en: Either way, what you're describing seems to be a president who doesn't seem all that prepared
sentences.zh: 无论如何，你所描述的似乎是一个并不怎么准备好

sentences.en: to tell people what they don't want to hear and to have to make really tough choices within the Democratic agenda.
sentences.zh: 告诉人们他们不想听的话，并且不得不在民主党议程内部做出极其艰难抉择的总统。

sentences.en: So how do you start to understand that?
sentences.zh: 那么你该如何开始理解这一点呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's a spot-on description of the political character we're dealing with in Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是对我们在乔·拜登身上打交道的这种政治特质的精准描述。

sentences.en: I think that what you see over the course of 21 is the personal characteristics and leadership traits
sentences.zh: 我认为你在2021年期间所看到的是，那些个人特质和领导风格——

sentences.en: that made it so possible for him to build and maintain this broad anti-Trump coalition in 2020
sentences.zh: 正是这些特质使得他在2020年有可能建立并维持这个庞大的反特朗普联盟——

sentences.en: start to cut in the other direction when actually you do need to disappoint some people.
sentences.zh: 当真正需要让某些人失望时，开始朝着相反的方向起作用。

sentences.en: You talk to people who know him really well, and some of them ascribe that to the long time
sentences.zh: 你跟那些非常了解他的人谈过，他们有些人将此归咎于他在参议院度过的大量时间，

sentences.en: that he spent in the Senate, which is an institution that's about personal relationships and building
sentences.zh: 那是一个关于人际关系、建立信任、和睦相处以及妥协的机构，

sentences.en: trust and getting along and a compromise, or at least that's what it was like, according to Joe Biden, when he was there.
sentences.zh: 或者至少按照乔·拜登的说法，当他在那里的时候，情况就是这样的。

sentences.en: And the other part of it, Michael, is his own persistent indecision about what kind of president he wants to be.
sentences.zh: 而另一部分原因，迈克尔，则是他对自己想成为什么样的总统长期存在的不确定性。

sentences.en: That if you're really, really invested in being FDR and enacting change on the scale of FDR, then clearly you need to have a set of tools and a set of incentives for getting
sentences.zh: 如果你真的非常投入于成为富兰克林·罗斯福并进行罗斯福规模的变革，那么显然你需要有一套工具和一套激励机制，来让

sentences.en: somebody like Joe Manchin or Kyrsten Sinema on board with that agenda that Biden has never demonstrated that he has.
sentences.zh: 像乔·曼钦或基尔斯滕·西内马这样的人支持那个拜登从未表现出自己拥有的议程。

sentences.en: And if you want to be the more sort of middle of the road, uniter, centrist Joe Biden, then
sentences.zh: 而如果你想成为那种更偏向中间道路、团结者、温和派的乔·拜登，那么

sentences.en: you need to be prepared to tell the left that many of the things that they want to get done are not actually going to get done because they're not realistic.
sentences.zh: 你就必须准备好告诉左翼，他们想要完成的许多事情实际上是无法完成的，因为它们并不现实。

sentences.en: So by the time his poll numbers are starting to decline, it would seem pretty clear that
sentences.zh: 因此，当他的民调支持率开始下降时，很明显，

sentences.en: not making these crucial decisions, not having these hard conversations is becoming very consequential to his presidency.
sentences.zh: 不做出这些至关重要的决定，不进行这些艰难的对话，正对他的总统任期产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: And the other thing that's becoming clear, right, Alex, is that his successes, which are meaningful, you know, the COVID relief bill and the infrastructure bill.
sentences.zh: 另一件变得清楚的事情是，对吧，亚历克斯，那就是他的成功——这些是有意义的，你知道的，新冠救助法案和基础设施法案——

sentences.en: Those are not breaking through to people.
sentences.zh: 并没有真正触及普通民众。

sentences.en: They're certainly not breaking through in a way that defines Biden's image as the president.
sentences.zh: 它们当然没有以那种能够定义拜登总统形象的方式深入人心。

sentences.en: But what you have is a president who has recorded some significant victories and then kind of vanished into the legislative process.
sentences.zh: 但你所拥有的是一位取得了一些重大胜利，随后却隐身于立法过程中的总统。

sentences.en: But in the summer of 21, when he has passed a $2 trillion coronavirus relief bill, when they
sentences.zh: 但在21年夏天，当他通过了一项两万亿美元的冠状病毒救助法案，当他们

sentences.en: have distributed tens of millions of vaccines, when people are starting to go back to work,
sentences.zh: 分发了数千万剂疫苗，当人们开始重返工作岗位时，

sentences.en: it's not that happy days are here again, but there are significant signs of progress for the country under Biden's stewardship.
sentences.zh: 并不是说好日子又回来了，但在拜登的领导下，国家出现了明显的进步迹象。

sentences.en: And I would challenge you or anybody listening to this to think of one time that they can remember
sentences.zh: 我要向你或任何听到这话的人发起挑战，让他们想出一个他们能记住的时刻，

sentences.en: seeing Joe Biden, you know, wearing a fireman's hat and standing in a station that was only saved from closure because of the money in the American rescue plan.
sentences.zh: 看到乔·拜登，你知道的，戴着消防员的帽子，站在一个仅仅因为美国救援计划的资金而免于关闭的消防站里。

sentences.en: Or standing in a school that was only in session because of vaccination program that he supervised or
sentences.zh: 或者站在一所仅仅因为他监督的疫苗接种计划而能够开学的学校里，

sentences.en: standing at a groundbreaking for a road or a bridge or an electric vehicle charging station that was funded by the infrastructure law.
sentences.zh: 或者站在由基础设施法资助的道路、桥梁或电动汽车充电站的动工仪式上。

sentences.en: It's not that he's done none of it, but he's not done it with the consistency or the intensity
sentences.zh: 这并不是说他什么都没做，但他没有以必要的一致性或强度去做这件事，

sentences.en: that would be necessary in order for the American people to think of Joe Biden and think of those accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 以至于美国人民在想到乔·拜登时能联想到这些成就。

sentences.en: So that's how you start to get to an approval rating below 40 percent.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他的支持率会开始跌到40%以下。

sentences.en: It's how you start to get into a situation where rather than being seen as this unifying figure who
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你会陷入这样一种境地：比起被视为那个打败了特朗普并治愈了国家的团结象征，

sentences.en: beat Trump and healed the country or as this bold liberal transformer, you instead start to get seen
sentences.zh: 或者是那个大胆的自由主义变革者，你反而开始被视为

sentences.en: as this sort of passive, conventional, risk averse figure who isn't keeping up with the mood of the country and emerging challenges that you didn't anticipate, like inflation.
sentences.zh: 那种被动的、传统的、规避风险的人物，无法跟上国家情绪以及你没有预料到的新兴挑战（比如通货膨胀）。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 解锁《纽约时报》应用。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能查阅所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《纽约时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Alex, given everything you've just walked us through, how are the Democrats approaching the midterm elections?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚历克斯，鉴于你刚刚带我们回顾的一切，民主党人将如何应对中期选举？

sentences.en: What is their message, given this very muddled legacy of the first 18 months of the Biden presidency?
sentences.zh: 鉴于拜登总统头18个月这份非常混乱的政治遗产，他们的核心诉求是什么？

sentences.en: Michael, for Democrats who are running in the most competitive elections of 2022, you have seen
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，对于那些在2022年竞选竞争最激烈职位的民主党人来说，你已经看到了

sentences.en: a real move to lean hard into the concrete accomplishments that Democrats have put together.
sentences.zh: 一种真正的转变，那就是大力倚重民主党人所取得的具体成就。

sentences.en: We need to upgrade our infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 我们需要升级我们的基础设施。

sentences.en: It's good for our future.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的未来有好处。

sentences.en: It's good for our quality of life.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的生活质量有好处。

sentences.en: Good for families.

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
